body:
Scope note from the lane seat (skills-lane self-triage; no re-grade, card stays `pm:queue`): flight ⑧ of the factual sweep (#13815 / PR #13833) measured the INVERSE of this card's phantom-row direction as the dominant falsehood class — 15 of its 20 false landing sites were enumerations that stopped growing when the schema did (a live schema member with NO doc row: `_tabs`, `pages`, `flows`, `setSupportedLocales`, 9-of-14 CLI kinds…). When this gate is built, it should carry BOTH directions over the same corpus: (1) this card's original leg — a skill row citing an identifier that greps to zero repo-wide is a red; (2) the inverse leg — a doc enumeration presented as exhaustive whose row set is a strict subset of the schema's member set is a red (the presented-as-exhaustive predicate needs care: `e.g.` lists are not falsifiable by omission, per flight ⑥'s recorded reading). One gate, two legs, one corpus walk. Evidence trail: #13815's report; flight ⑤ found the same shape (10-member enum, 9 rows; 20-member ChartType, 19 rows); flight ⑦ (driver catalog missing two live ids). Serial note stands: this card still waits on PR #13584's `.github/workflows/lint.yml` face before dispatch.

Read-coupling with in-flight sweep drafts (#13833, #13861 pending merge; flight ⑩ in flight): their merges change `skills/**` content that this gate BASELINES — the brief requires the gate to be green on whatever tree it lands on and robust to those merges (identifier-level predicates, not count pins, wherever possible).

## ACCEPT — PR #13892; non-governed scripts face ⇒ seat lands via the queue on full-green CI

Reviewed against GitHub, not the report: draft ✓ · `Fixes #13678` ✓ · diff = new gate + self-test + registrations, ZERO `skills/**` edits (the six current gaps LEDGERED with declared kinds, not fixed — exactly the green-on-landing-tree contract) ✓ · both ablation legs blob-hash-proven (phantom row → exit 1 with the located verdict; deleted bulk row → exit 1; restores proven by HEAD-blob equality) ✓ · 33 derived families all exit 0, repo-wide `pnpm lint` run in full, remedy-authority CONTROL row + bare-root-worklist REFUSE-WIDE row + watch hints all registered per the farm's own conventions ✓.

Design verdicts accepted, both measurement-backed: Leg 1's implementation-only word index (self-test pins each exclusion — an index containing the teaching corpus is a green light wired to nothing); Leg 2 table-driven with the inference heuristic demoted to a non-failing `--suggest` (1-in-3 true-positive rate measured on the real corpus — shipping that as a red would have been noise). Verdict line at head: 500 citations / 48 files / 91,177 implementation tokens · 9 registered exhaustive sections · ledgers shrink-only.

**Open question (ApproverType vs check:role-word) — answer: B, routed to the sweep program.** The tenth member is documented under the D3 projection spelling the spec file itself names (`org_membership_level` vocabulary), which keeps both gates green and makes the capability reachable without weakening the customer-facing vocabulary ratchet; it is a `skills/**` content change, so it rides the program roster (recorded on #13658's follow-up trail with #13890), not this card. Option C (a scoped role-word baseline hole) is declined. The AggregationMetricType design observation stays unfiled per the dev's read — a design note without a defect; it is recorded in the round report for the spec lane's awareness.

Terminal: ready + auto-merge once EVERY check on #13892 is green (4 were converging at review time); card closes via `Fixes` at merge. Sub-issue #13890 verified filed under the program.
